description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa arrangement in the living area facing inward toward the TV on the interior wall. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is living area, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families; households needing multiple bedrooms; those requiring a home office with natural light; wheelchair users needing wide straight circulation.
not_suitable_for: those requiring a home office with natural light
